scripts.check: pnpm -r run check && uv run --project backend ruff check backend && uv run --project backend mypy --config-file backend/pyproject.toml backend/src && pnpm contracts:check
scripts.test:unit: pnpm -r run test:unit && uv run --project backend pytest backend/tests/unit -q
scripts.test:security: playwright test tests/e2e/renderer.spec.ts && uv run --project backend pytest backend/tests/unit/test_access_policy.py backend/tests/integration -q
